tools.name: shop_info
tools.description: The shirts lookunique prints: the cuts with their prices, colours, sizes, print sizes, front or back printing, the countries it ships to, how long printing takes, and the returns rule.

tools.name: draw_shirt
tools.description: Draws a one-of-a-kind t-shirt design from a short idea in the person’s own words, in any language (3–140 characters), such as “a fox reading the morning paper”. For a shirt idea, a gift or merch. Makes four pictures in the shop’s dot-drawing style; returns the first as soon as it is ready, with the

tools.name: draw_from_photo
tools.description: Turns an image into a t-shirt design in the shop’s dot-drawing style: a person’s photo, or a picture an AI assistant made in this conversation (“put this on a t-shirt”). Takes the image as a file (`photo`) or as an https link (`photo_url`). Makes three pictures; returns the first as soon as it is re

tools.name: photo_upload_link
tools.description: A one-time lookunique.eu page, valid for 30 minutes, where the person can drop a photo or saved picture from their device. The drawing starts on that page and belongs to this conversation.

tools.name: print_words
tools.description: Sets the person’s own words as lettering on a t-shirt — a name, a phrase, a team, a date — in one to three lines of up to 48 characters. Returns four layouts at once.

tools.name: check_drawing
tools.description: Where a drawing stands: its pictures so far, each with a design_id, what is still being drawn, and anything the shop’s own check found missing. Without drawing_id it reads this conversation’s newest drawing.

tools.name: show_shirt
tools.description: A picture of one design on a real shirt, in the chosen cut (garment), colour, print size (s/m/l) and side, with its price and the colours this design can be printed on.

tools.name: order_link
tools.description: The link that opens exactly this shirt on lookunique.eu, ready to order, with its price, after checking that the colour suits the design and the size is in stock. The address, the payment and the terms are on lookunique.eu; nothing is bought here.
